architecture.framework: TanStack Start v1 — full-stack React framework with file-based routing
architecture.package_manager: Bun — use bun, not npm/pnpm/yarn, for install/test/lint/build commands
architecture.database: none — static/marketing site, no DB currently
architecture.state_management: none needed for most pages — the live 'health.json' widget likely uses local component state to render the animated/ticking Health Score display
architecture.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 — via native CSS @theme tokens, not a tailwind.config.js-based token system
architecture.component_system: shadcn/ui — components are vendored into the repo (copy-in, not npm-installed), so Dependency Police should not treat shadcn additions the same as adding a new package dependency
architecture.design_system: Terminal Dark (Editorial) — see design-system section below. This is a hard constraint, not a suggestion: Palette must never introduce a color, font, or border-radius outside these tokens.
patterns: Shared form component for the /audit and contact forms (consolidated 2026-07-24 — do not re-split these back into separate components)

A 'health.json' live-styled widget renders Health Score data with a terminal/CLI aesthetic ($ ses scan --deep, etc.) — this component previously had a CRITICAL code-injection vulnerability, patched 2026-07-11
Strict security headers (HSTS + CSP) deployed 2026-07-17 — any new third-party script/embed must be added to the CSP allowlist or it will silently break
File-based routing (TanStack Start convention) — pages observed: / (home), /pricing, /evidence, /audit, /about, /privacy, /terms, /security, /status

design_system.name: Terminal Dark (Editorial)
design_system.vibe: high-contrast, minimal, engineering-focused — like a dark IDE or terminal session

colors.accent: #22c55e — terminal green, this is the ONLY accent color, do not introduce a second accent
colors.secondary_text: #999999 — WCAG AA-compliant gray, replacing low-contrast #666666 for eyebrows and labels

design_system.border_radius: max 3px — sharp, editorial, never rounded pills or cards
design_system.voice: monospace code comments, volume labels ('VOL. I — THE PROBLEM'), CLI-style CTAs ('$ audit --free ↵')
design_system.core_line: "Software doesn't stay finished. It either evolves or decays."
design_system.note_for_agents: three font families (Space Grotesk, Inter, JetBrains Mono) are loaded on this site — Bolt should check the font-loading strategy (font-display, preload, subsetting) as a real performance lever, not add or remove a font family without checking this section first.

conventions.type_safety: TypeScript strict mode is already enabled — Architecture Guardian and Sentinel should treat any `any` type or `// @ts-ignore` introduced by a PR as a red flag, not business-as-usual

never_touch: the audit/contact form submission handler — no test coverage yet, and it's the site's only lead-gen mechanism
the health.json live widget / chart rendering component — recently patched for a CRITICAL injection vulnerability, treat with extra scrutiny
CSP/HSTS header configuration — do not loosen without explicit reason logged here

the Tailwind v4 @theme token file / design-system CSS variables — colors, fonts, and border-radius are fixed to the Terminal Dark (Editorial) system; changes here require the founder's explicit sign-off, not an agent's judgment call

known_issues.area: cold start / infrastructure — INVESTIGATED, closed as low-priority
known_issues.issue: Investigated across three rounds of evidence (Vercel request logs, deployment static-asset breakdown, Observability Functions dashboard). Findings: (1) index-CbnyoU4-.js (the file that spiked to 6.68s in the original test) is a STATIC ASSET served via CDN, not through the /__server function — so function-level metrics can't explain it, and it did not reproduce on a repeat test (clean 571ms load). Most likely a one-off local network/edge-cache anomaly. (2) The /__server function DOES show real (non-demo) cold starts — 13.6% Cold / 81.8% Hot / 4.5% Prewarmed over 22 invocations in 12h — but sample size is tiny (near-certainly founder's own test traffic) and even cold invocations show fast Active CPU (P95 154ms). (3) The Time-to-First-Byte panel that would show real user-perceived cold-start latency is Vercel-Hobby-plan 'Demo Data', not real — would need a Pro upgrade to see actual numbers, not worth doing pre-launch.
known_issues.status: CLOSED — not worth further investigation at current (near-zero) traffic levels. Revisit only if real post-launch traffic shows a pattern of slow first-loads via analytics/user reports. Not a priority for the next Bolt cycle.

known_issues.issue: Real Lighthouse audit run 2026-07-26 (incognito, cache disabled): Performance 98/100, Accessibility 96/100, Best Practices 100/100, SEO 100/100. FCP 0.8s, LCP 0.8s, TBT 0ms, CLS 0. This supersedes the earlier 'Performance pillar at 0/100' entry — 0 always meant 'unmeasured,' not 'bad,' and the real number is excellent. Remaining Bolt work is now small/incremental: 47.6 KiB of unused JS in index-CbnyoU4-.js, and the PR #24 Formspree preconnect is flagged by Lighthouse itself as 'Unused preconnect' — worth downgrading to dns-prefetch or removing.
known_issues.status: baseline established — no longer a priority gap, minor optimizations only

known_issues.issue: Lighthouse (2026-07-26) found text-[#666] on #0c0c0c background fails WCAG contrast requirements — affects eyebrow/label text site-wide ('THE PROBLEM', 'THE SERVICE', 'industry avg', etc.). The design_system block does not currently define an official WCAG-compliant secondary/muted-text color, so this needs a founder decision (pick and formally add a compliant gray, e.g. around #999) before Palette applies a fix — see fingerprint.json agent_behavior_modifiers.palette.
known_issues.status: open — next Palette cycle, pending founder's color choice

known_issues.area: site health widget — data integrity question, not a technical bug
known_issues.issue: The homepage's '● live' health.json widget displays 73. This doesn't match health-score.json's real Performance:0 (as of last Scribe report), a separately-observed 'Performance 67' in DevTools, or the real Lighthouse 98 captured 2026-07-26. Four different numbers suggest the homepage widget shows demo/illustrative content rather than data actually wired to health-score.json, despite the 'live' label implying otherwise.
known_issues.status: open — needs a deliberate founder decision (wire it to real data, or relabel/caveat it), not an agent fix. Worth resolving given the business's own 'evidence over opinion' positioning.

previous_prs.change: Deployed strict HTTP security headers — HSTS and a robust Content Security Policy
Consolidated the contact and audit forms into a single shared component; standardized accessibility (linked form labels, screen-reader-friendly validation feedback) across all forms site-wide
Added preconnect hints for Plausible Analytics and Formspree, plus a rel=preload for the Google Fonts stylesheet, in the root route head config
previous_prs.impact: Claimed ~150-250ms font latency reduction and ~200-400ms form-connection reduction — not labeled as measured vs. estimated (see note)
previous_prs.note: Two real, useful facts surfaced by this diff and now confirmed in client-dna.json/fingerprint.json: (1) Plausible Analytics is installed — Pulse can potentially be enabled now; (2) Formspree is the form backend. Two open concerns not yet resolved: (a) the preload likely duplicates work the browser's preload scanner already did, since the stylesheet link was already present in initial HTML before this PR — verify in DevTools Network waterfall whether it actually changes request timing; (b) preconnecting to Formspree on every single page load has a real (small) cost paid by all visitors to benefit only those who submit a form — Business Impact Validator's 100/100 approval didn't weigh this tradeoff explicitly. Evidence-honesty issue from PR #23 (estimated numbers presented without labeling them as estimates) recurred here unchanged — flagging this once didn't fix it; needs to be enforced in .Jules/skills/evidence-assembler.md itself before the next cycle.
previous_prs.status: merged — pending founder verification of the two open concerns above
